description:
Add a new contact to YOUR agency's CRM. Use when the agent wants to
save a person (buyer, owner, enquirer). If a contact with the same
email already exists it is returned rather than duplicated. The contact
is created unassigned and flagged as needing attention so it surfaces
in the CRM. Requires a linked PropertyList account (or an agency API
key).

company_name.description: Company name (for a business contact). Optional.

email.description: Email address. Optional but recommended (used for de-duplication).

name: create_contact

status.description: exists: a contact with this email was already in the CRM, and nothing was added.

title: Create contact
